records.animalos__Content__c: Max is friendly with children and other dogs. Walks well on leash. Knows basic commands (sit, stay, shake). Would suit an active family.
Bella is nervous around loud noises and sudden movements. Requires a calm, quiet environment during her stray hold assessment period. Shows signs of previous neglect.

Rocky displays leash reactivity towards other dogs. Currently on a desensitisation program with the behaviour team. Only experienced handlers should walk him. Progress is steady - reduced lunging distance from 5m to 2m.
Deep clean of all kennels completed. New enrichment toys distributed. Water bowls replaced with anti-tip models.
Whiskers diagnosed with mild upper respiratory infection on intake. Started on antibiotics. Must be isolated from other cats until cleared by vet. Recheck scheduled for 2026-04-10.
